data.title: 尤贝尔 · 旅店里的皮带修补
data.description: 旅店午休时，尤贝尔穿酒红衬衫和棕马甲坐在窗边，把松开的皮包带平放在桌上。她一手压住皮带，另一手将黄铜扣穿回扣眼，拉紧后微微一笑，像是享受这件微不足道却顺利完成的小事。
data.action: 把包带压在桌上穿回黄铜扣，拉紧检查后微笑。
data.promptProse: Ubel presses a loose leather bag strap against the inn table with one hand and guides its brass buckle through the next hole with the other. After a testing pull, she offers an amused half-smile under her green side ponytail. Burgundy sleeves and brown waistcoat stay clear of the work. In the medium view, side-window sunlight glints on brass and purple eyes, with timber boards receding behind and shade beneath the strap.
